candidates.change_summary: Change the ternary condition to always set unlockTime to block.timestamp.
Swap the addition in the require to use a wrong inequality that still passes but changes behavior only via overflow (if unchecked).
Change the require to be always true by using an always-satisfied condition.
Change the addition to subtraction, so balance decreases when it should increase.

Change the condition from 'acc.balance>=MinSum && acc.balance>=_am && block.timestamp>acc.unlockTime' to 'acc.balance>=MinSum && acc.balance>=_am && block.timestamp>=acc.unlockTime' (using >= instead of > for the timestamp check).

Change the condition from 'acc.balance>=MinSum && acc.balance>=_am && block.timestamp>acc.unlockTime' to 'acc.balance>MinSum && acc.balance>=_am && block.timestamp>acc.unlockTime' (using > instead of >= for the MinSum check).
Change the subtraction to addition: 'acc.balance = (acc.balance - _am)' becomes 'acc.balance = (acc.balance + _am)'.

Remove the requirement that the sender's balance must be at least _am: change 'acc.balance>=MinSum && acc.balance>=_am && block.timestamp>acc.unlockTime' to 'acc.balance>=MinSum && block.timestamp>acc.unlockTime'.
Swap the order of operations: move the external call before the balance update (still inside the if block).
Delete the external call and logging, leaving only the balance subtraction.
